tools.name: extract
tools.description: Web page to Markdown: fetch any public URL and return its main readable content as clean Markdown (reader mode), plus title, description and word count. Ideal for LLM context and RAG. Not charged if the page cannot be fetched. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Website metadata / link preview: title, description, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, canonical URL, language, favicon, image, author, published date, RSS feeds and H1/H2 headings of any public URL. Not charged on fetch errors. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: links
tools.description: Extract all links from a web page: absolute URLs with anchor text, internal/external and nofollow flags, de-duplicated (up to 500). Useful for crawling, sitemaps and link audits. Not charged on fetch errors. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS lookup: resolve A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, SRV or CAA records for any domain over encrypted DNS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1), with TTLs, status (NOERROR/NXDOMAIN) and DNSSEC validation flag. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: whois
tools.description: Domain WHOIS (RDAP) lookup: registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC for any domain, from the official registry RDAP service. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: fx
tools.description: Currency exchange rates and conversion: latest official European Central Bank reference rates for ~30 fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, SEK, ...). Convert an amount from one currency to one or more others. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Wallet balance: native coin balance plus USDC/USDT (or any ERC-20 tokens you list) for an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Also returns nonce (transaction count) and whether the address is a contract. Price: $0.001 USDC per success

tools.name: token
tools.description: ERC-20 token info: name, symbol, decimals and total supply of any token contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: tx
tools.description: Transaction status and details on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain: success/failed/pending, block, time, confirmations, from/to, value, fee, and decoded ERC-20/NFT token transfers with symbols and amounts. Use it to verify a payment. Price: $0

tools.name: gas
tools.description: Live gas prices across chains in one call: gas price, base fee and priority fee (gwei), latest block, and the cost of a plain transfer, for Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: ens
tools.description: ENS and Basenames lookup: resolve a name (vitalik.eth, jesse.base.eth) to its address, or an address to its verified primary ENS name and Basename. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: AI summary of any public web page: fetches the URL, extracts the readable text and returns a concise Markdown summary (short, medium or long) in the page's language. Not charged on fetch or AI errors. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about a web page: fetches the URL and answers from the page content only (answer is null when the page does not say). Good for pulling one fact out of a page. Not charged on fetch or AI errors. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: translate
tools.description: AI translation of text into any language (Swedish, German, Spanish, Chinese, Persian, ...), keeping meaning, tone, names, numbers and formatting. Up to 4000 characters per call. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: chat
tools.description: One-shot AI chat completion (Google Gemma 4 26B): send a prompt and optional system instruction, get the answer. Up to 2000 characters in and about 800 tokens out. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: image
tools.description: AI image generation from a text prompt (FLUX.1 schnell, 1024x1024 JPEG returned as a base64 data URL). Sexual or graphic prompts are refused and not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: price
tools.description: Crypto and gold/silver prices in USD from Chainlink oracle price feeds, read on-chain: BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, USDC, USDT, LINK, AVAX, UNI, AAVE, ARB and more, up to 25 per call, with each feed's last update time. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: tokenprice
tools.description: Price of any ERC-20 token by contract address, read on-chain from DEX pools (Uniswap v3 on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP, Polygon; Aerodrome on Base): USD price, deepest pool, its liquidity, and other pools. Read-only. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: quote
tools.description: DEX swap quote: how much of token B you would get for an amount of token A, best route over Uniswap v3 (direct or via WETH) and Aerodrome, with alternatives and gas estimate. Quote only, nothing is traded. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Weather forecast for any place on Earth by latitude/longitude: current conditions, the next 24 hours hour by hour, and daily min/max temperature, precipitation and sky for about 9 days. Data from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0). Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: airquality
tools.description: Air quality near any point: current PM2.5 and PM10 (median of nearby outdoor sensors), US AQI with category, and European Air Quality Index level. Best coverage in Europe. Data from Sensor.Community citizen sensors. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: time
tools.description: Current time (or any given moment) in up to 20 IANA time zones: local date and time, weekday, UTC offset, abbreviation and daylight-saving status. Also converts a timestamp between zones and to Unix time. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: random
tools.description: Cryptographically secure random values: integers in a range, floats, UUIDs, hex tokens, coin flips, dice, random picks from a list, list shuffles, or strong passwords. Up to 100 values per call. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: PDF to text: fetch a public PDF by URL (up to 8 MB) and return its full text as Markdown, with page metadata, ready for LLM context or RAG. Not charged if the file cannot be fetched or read. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Geocoding: place name to latitude/longitude worldwide (cities, towns, landmarks; with country, region, population and time zone), reverse geocoding from coordinates to the nearest place, and US street address to coordinates. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "random" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Cryptographically secure random values: integers in a range, floats, UUIDs, hex tokens, coin flips, dice, random picks from a list, list shuffles, or strong pas…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, meta, links, summarize, ask, chat, price, pdf · Private data: dns, balance, token, tx, chat, tokenprice, quote, random, pdf · Public sink: chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, meta, links, summarize, ask, chat, price, pdf · Private data: dns, balance, token, tx, chat, tokenprice, quote, random, pdf · Public sink: chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
